qualification: Technical references only; no runtime network-on/off qualification and no loopback exemption has been configured.

facts: AppContainer resource access is the intersection of user/group and package/capability grants.
Explicit package/capability access can allow writing objects at Medium IL without lowering their labels.
Loopback connections require separate configuration; internet capability alone is not a localhost qualification.
Setting loopback exemptions must preserve all already configured SIDs by reading the existing configuration first.
The API documentation describes this exemption as intended for debugging.
